collections.description: The semantic anchor of the EDM. Every Foundation-layer enterprise concept inherits from Entity to declare, "I am an enterprise thing." Entity carries only the absolute minimum: a globally unique surrogate identifier that never changes across systems, reorganizations, or integrations. Entity is deliberately minimal. Cross-cutting concerns (natural keys, audit timestamps, lifecycle state, classification, addresses, role participation, bitemporal validity) are NOT on Entity; they live in Common base types (Identifiable, Lifecycleable, Addressable, Classifiable, RoleHolder, Temporal) and are composed onto entities that need them. Entity is concrete (abstract: false) — in rare cases it may be instantiated directly, but in practice every Foundation concept specializes it.

buckets.name: Foundation
buckets.description: The permanent enterprise concepts. Entity is the root; Person, Organization (LegalEntity, OrganizationalUnit), Team, Role, Activity, Agreement, Asset, Address, Document and Period specialise it. Every Domain, Process and Application entity specialises exactly one of these kinds and carries its attributes (D12). Entity and Organization are never tables (edmAbstract).

properties.name: value
properties.description: The identifier value itself.

properties.name: scheme
properties.description: The naming/numbering scheme. Examples: "employee_number", "tax_id", "iso_country_code", "ein", "ssn".

properties.name: issuer
properties.description: The authority that issued this identifier. Examples: "Acme HR", "IRS", "ISO", "National Social Security Administration".

properties.name: issued_at
properties.description: When the identifier was issued (if known).

properties.name: valid_from
properties.description: When this identifier becomes effective.

properties.name: valid_to
properties.description: When this identifier ceases to be effective (for reissued keys).
A natural/business identifier value paired with the scheme that issued it and the issuer. Example: value="E10847", scheme="Acme employee number", issuer="Acme Corp HR".
properties.name: NaturalIdentifier
from_state
properties.description: The prior lifecycle state (as enum string value).

properties.name: to_state
properties.description: The new lifecycle state (as enum string value).

properties.name: transition_timestamp
properties.description: When the transition occurred.

properties.name: transitioned_by_entity_type
properties.description: Entity type of transitioned by: one of Person, Role, Team. Polymorphic reference: no relationship (docs/patterns/polymorphic_references.md).

properties.name: transitioned_by_entity_id
properties.description: The actor responsible for the transition. Typically references a Person (via their entity_id), but may be a system/service account in automated transitions.

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Free-text reason or note explaining the transition.
A single transition from one lifecycle state to another. Captured as immutable history on any Lifecycleable entity. Enables audit trails and point-in-time reconstruction of lifecycle history.
properties.name: StateTransition
value
properties.description: The numeric amount (positive or negative).

properties.name: currency
properties.description: ISO 4217 currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, ...). Format: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code.

properties.name: precision
properties.description: Decimal precision (digits after the decimal point). Defaults to the currency's standard minor-unit precision if omitted (typically 2 for most currencies, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD, etc.).
A monetary amount: a decimal numeric value with its ISO 4217 currency code. Used wherever money appears in the model.
properties.name: AmountType
system_id
properties.description: Identifier of the document within its source system (URI, document ID, file path).

properties.name: source_system
properties.description: The document management system that holds this document (e.g., "sharepoint", "google-drive", "docusign-envelope").

properties.name: version
properties.description: Document version identifier.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Document status (e.g., "draft", "final", "signed", "archived"). Free-text because document status vocabularies vary widely across DMS platforms.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Human-readable document title.

properties.name: mime_type
properties.description: MIME type of the document (e.g., "application/pdf").

properties.name: url
properties.description: Direct URL to retrieve the document (if available).
A reference to a document stored in an external document management system (SharePoint, Google Drive, DocuSign, etc.).
